key_decisions: A Continue still RUNS the stage-1 sampler (node 70 LTXVNormalizingSampler, titled Stage1_Bypass, is absent from execution_cached); only the latent SAVE is gated. THE USER ACCEPTED THIS rather than re-authoring the graph, so PROGRESS_STAGES.stage2 was corrected 1 -> 3 to match reality. Do NOT 'fix' this as a bug without asking — the count now encodes the accepted behaviour.

The Preview_Only warning that fires on EVERY LTX generation is dead noise and was left in place deliberately. is_preview demonstrably drives the preview via Video_Latent.is_preview; narrowing comfyController's defensive guard is a fleet-wide change to a check that still protects every other model.

The end-frame gate is the SLOT LIST, not a model list: i2v_ms declares an endFrame slot, single-stage i2v no longer does. Its only consumer is Wan 2.2 5B, whose graph has no Input_End_Frame node, so the slot was undeliverable and the UI would have offered a control that does nothing.
The frame-role pill CLEARS the tag rather than setting 'startFrame', letting the positional fill own the default — that is what keeps a lone untagged image on the start frame.

The bench/engine version skew (0.30.2 vs 0.30.0) is REAL but was NOT the cause of the widget bug — that was our own converter. Do not bump the engine on account of it. The engine bump has its own cards (MPI-457/467/468).
